{{< irish counties >}}

Each county has its own page, with its population at every census since 1841, the average rent on new tenancies since 2008, and how it compares with the other counties on income, house prices, new homes, renting, the Irish language, people born abroad, working from home, driving to work, distance to health services and forest cover. The figures come from the same Central Statistics Office tables as the maps on the topic pages.
